title: PrivateNote Edition
description: Config-only contract for a PrivateNote edition (Therapist first). An edition is pure configuration + assets layered over the untouched Vibe engine. Creating this config does NOT modify the engine or tauri.conf.json; a later, separately-reviewed generator applies build-time identity on a rebrand branch.

soap_notes.description: MUST be false for Therapist v1 (medical overlay). Enabling is a later founder gate.

cloud_ai.description: MUST be false for Therapist v1. No audio/text leaves the device.
